sq.q: What is meant by inner evolution?
answer: Inner evolution is the continuous growth of the self through better understanding, awareness, and refinement of thoughts, leading to a harmonious and meaningful life.

sq.q: Why is self-exploration important in inner evolution?
answer: Self-exploration helps us examine our desires, thoughts, and actions, so we can identify whether they are based on right understanding or mere assumptions.

Existence means all that exists. In UHV, existence is understood as co-existence: units submerged in space. Units are limited in size and active, while space is unlimited, all-pervading and no-activity. Every unit is energised in space, self-organised in space, and recognises and fulfils its relationship with other units in space. Units may be material units or consciousness units. Material units have the activity of recognising and fulfilling, while consciousness has knowing, assuming, recognising and fulfilling. The four orders of nature are made of such units. Existence is not a collection of isolated things; it is an ordered reality where units exist together in space. Therefore, harmony is inherent in existence. The role of the human being is to understand this co-existence and live with the feeling of co-existence.
